lead.event: Rupiah reaches a record low against the US dollar
lead.headline: Rupiah reaches record low of Rp18,319/US$ in NDF market
lead.blurb: The NDF quote was recorded at 23:39 WIB, with spot trading expected to remain under pressure on 20 November. The rupiah is forecast to trade at Rp18,230-18,300/US$, with technical targets of Rp18,280-18,300/US$ and medium-term weakness to Rp18,400/US$ if its trendline channel breaks. Pressure reflects a stronger dollar, rising Federal Reserve tightening expectations and domestic political and fiscal concerns.

market_structure_policy.event: Indonesia introduces a severance reserve fund rule
market_structure_policy.headline: Indonesia introduces severance reserve fund rule due by 28 October 2027
market_structure_policy.blurb: The requirement under Law No. 27 of 2026 shifts severance from a liability paid at termination to funds set aside in advance. Gajah Tunggal had Rp1.86 trillion in post-employment benefit liabilities in June 2026, while Pan Brothers had 23,762 employees and US$7.63 million in cash.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: XLSMART prepares an Rp1 trillion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: EXCL prepares share buyback of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The buyback is planned to run from 23 November to 22 February and will be funded from internal cash. XLSMART may repurchase shares gradually or all at once, depending on market conditions.

capital_raising_buybacks.headline: PRDA completes 2026 buyback of 36.14 million shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Prodia repurchased the shares for Rp112.42 billion, including transaction costs, at an average Rp3,033 each during a program that ran from 20 August to 19 November. Its treasury holdings now total 83.86 million shares, or 8.95% of paid-up capital, below the 20% maximum.

other.event: Paragon subsidiary signs a coal sales contract with Xiangyu Trading Indonesia
other.headline: PKPK subsidiary signs Rp1.38 trillion coal contract with Xiangyu Trading Indonesia
other.blurb: Through Tri Oetama Persada, Paragon will supply 1 million metric tons from November 2026 to December 2027 at an estimated US$76 per ton. PKPK expects the agreement to optimize mining operations, increase sales certainty and support consolidated revenue.

other.event: Adhi Karya faces a PKPU petition from two creditors
other.headline: ADHI faces PKPU petition from two creditors
other.blurb: Adhi Karya says Atap Perkasa and Satek Aire Indonesia filed the petition on 17 November. Its 30 September liabilities were Rp23.46 trillion against assets of Rp26.77 trillion. It has not received official court notice and will verify the petition on receipt, saying it expects no significant impact on operations or finances.
other.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: As of 30 September 2026, ADHI reported liabilities of Rp23.46 trillion and assets of Rp26.77 trillion.

earnings_guidance.event: Astrindo reports nine-month results and maintains its 2026 revenue target
earnings_guidance.headline: BIPI keeps its approximately US$140 million 2026 target as nine-month revenue falls 34.23%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Astrindo's PSEL Cipeucang project is planned to handle about 1,100 tons of waste per day and roughly 25 MW of capacity. January-September revenue was US$128.13 million, while net profit of US$5.51 million reversed a US$5.41 million loss.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from lead to story

earnings_guidance.event: Timah reports Rp4.12 trillion in nine-month net profit
earnings_guidance.headline: TINS reports Rp4.12 trillion in nine-month net profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: Timah’s revenue rose 144% year on year to Rp16.15 trillion, supported by increased ore supply and stronger global tin prices. Tin ore output reached 18,893 tons by September, and the company targets 25,000 tons for full-year 2026.

earnings_guidance.event: BRI subsidiaries report profit growth through September 2026
earnings_guidance.headline: Subsidiaries report 43.5% profit growth through September 2026
earnings_guidance.blurb: BRI said its subsidiaries earned Rp11.8 trillion, contributing 24.4% of group profit. Deputy President Director Viviana Dyah Ayu R.K. attributed the growth to the Ultra Micro Holding synergy among BRI, Pegadaian and PNM, as well as gold business development.

deals_control.event: WIFI's controller reacquires a 26.67% stake from Sinergi Graha Kapital
deals_control.headline: WIFI controller buys back 26.67% stake from Sinergi Graha Kapital
deals_control.blurb: Solusi Sinergi Digital's controlling shareholder, Investasi Sukses Bersama, bought 1.41 billion shares on 19 November at Rp2,870 each, for Rp4.06 trillion. The purchase raised its stake to 54.42% and reversed its sale of the same block to Sinergi Graha Kapital on 19 October.

deals_control.event: AKR acquires BP Global's remaining stake in Aneka Petroindo Raya
deals_control.headline: AKRA acquires BP Global’s remaining 49.9% stake in APR for US$14.22 million
deals_control.blurb: AKR acquired 11,444,565 shares from BP Global Investments Limited, raising its ownership from 50.1% to 100% effective 6 November. APR will continue under the BP brand and its existing brand licence agreement.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: APR will continue under the BP brand and its existing brand licence agreement.

deals_control.event: Dharma Polimetal partners with Minth Group on EV components
deals_control.headline: DRMA partners Minth Group on EV components through Rp180 billion JV
deals_control.blurb: Dharma Polimetal established the joint venture in September 2026 to supply EV components, particularly aluminium extrusion for chassis and body structures. The project is part of the company's Rp400 billion capital expenditure plan for 2026.

deals_control.event: Inocycle agrees to divest its stake in Urecel Indonesia
deals_control.headline: INOV agrees to divest 45.8% stake in Urecel Indonesia for Rp260 billion
deals_control.blurb: Inocycle signed a conditional share purchase agreement with CIP Capital covering 11,450 shares in Urecel Indonesia. The proposed sale is valued at 71.1% of Inocycle’s equity as of 30 June 2026 and is subject to shareholder approval at an extraordinary meeting on 28 December.

flash.event: BCA declares a Q4 2026 interim dividend of Rp35 per share
flash.headline: Bank Central Asia (BBCA) sets a Rp35-per-share interim dividend for the fourth quarter of 2026
flash.copy_decision: rewritten: 3 new articles with a new fact: BCA's 2026 interim dividends total Rp80 per share, up 45.5% year on year.

flash.headline: Bank Tabungan Negara (BBTN.JK) reports Rp 2.82 trillion net profit for January-September 2026
flash.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: BTN raised financing growth guidance to 8%-11% and cut third-party funds growth guidance to 3%-5%.

flash.headline: Elnusa (ELSA) plans to resume a share buyback of up to Rp84.5 billion
flash.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: The buyback period runs through 19 February 2027.
